## {@name@} {#sec-t-{@slug@}}

```{r}
#| include: false
t <- "{@tenure@}"
tr <- ten[tenure == t]
## the name before a full stop, so "Ltd." does not end a caption with ".."
name_end <- sub("[.]$", "", tr$name)
pt <- rd$pct_type[tenure == t]
fa <- rd$forest[poly == t]
type_area <- setNames(fa$area_ha, fa$vegType)
types_shown <- fa[vegType != "All species" & area_ha >= min_ha, vegType]
types_small <- setdiff(fa[vegType != "All species" & area_ha > 0, vegType], types_shown)
af <- pt[vegType == "All species"][match(des$age_classes, ageClass)]
af[, phrase := report05_position_phrase(position, min, max, cc_rank)]

## age-class shares by vegetation type: all forest first, then the types big enough to show
panel_types <- c("All species", sort(types_shown))
panel_lab <- function(v) {
  factor(
    sprintf("%s (%s ha)", report05_veg_label(v), report05_ha(type_area[v])),
    levels = sprintf("%s (%s ha)", report05_veg_label(panel_types), report05_ha(type_area[panel_types]))
  )
}
tn <- rd$type_nrv[poly == t & vegType %in% panel_types][, panel := panel_lab(vegType)]
tc <- rd$type_cc[poly == t & vegType %in% panel_types][, panel := panel_lab(vegType)]
p_type <- report05_boxplot(tn, tc, des$age_classes, "Share of the type's forest area (%)")
h_type <- 1.6 * ceiling(length(panel_types) / 2) + 0.6
report05_save_png(p_type, fig_dir, paste0(t, "_types"), 6.5, h_type)
cap_type <- sprintf(
  "Simulated range (boxes) and current condition (red circles) of the share of forest in each age class, by vegetation type, in %s. The forested area of each type in the current condition is in brackets.",
  name_end
)

## all forest by ecological sub-region
fs <- rd$forest_sub[tenure == t & vegType == "All species"]
subs_shown <- fs[area_ha >= min_ha][order(-area_ha), subregion]
subs_small <- fs[area_ha < min_ha & area_ha > 0, subregion]
has_subs <- length(subs_shown) > 0L
if (has_subs) {
  sub_area <- setNames(fs$area_ha, fs$subregion)
  sub_lab <- function(s) {
    factor(
      sprintf("%s (%s ha)", s, report05_ha(sub_area[s])),
      levels = sprintf("%s (%s ha)", subs_shown, report05_ha(sub_area[subs_shown]))
    )
  }
  sn <- rd$sub_nrv[tenure == t & subregion %in% subs_shown][, panel := sub_lab(subregion)]
  sc <- rd$sub_cc[tenure == t & subregion %in% subs_shown][, panel := sub_lab(subregion)]
  p_sub <- report05_boxplot(sn, sc, des$age_classes, "Share of forest area (%)")
  h_sub <- 1.6 * ceiling(length(subs_shown) / 2) + 0.6
  report05_save_png(p_sub, fig_dir, paste0(t, "_subregions"), 6.5, h_sub)
  cap_sub <- sprintf(
    "Simulated range (boxes) and current condition (red circles) of the share of all forest in each age class, by %s, in %s. The forested area of each %s in the current condition is in brackets.",
    tr$sub_kind, name_end, tr$sub_kind
  )
}

## old forest in large patches
pn <- rd$patch_nrv[poly == t]
pc <- rd$patch_cc[poly == t]
pp <- rd$pct_patch[tenure == t][order(min_patch_ha)]
p_patch <- report05_patch_hist(pn, pc)
report05_save_png(p_patch, fig_dir, paste0(t, "_oldpatches"), 6.5, 4.6)
cap_patch <- sprintf(
  "Simulated range (grey bars, %d simulated landscapes) and current condition (red line) of the area of old forest in patches of at least %s ha, in %s.",
  n_snap, paste(report05_ha(des$patch_sizes_ha), collapse = ", "), name_end
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(
  sprintf(
    "%s covers %s ha, of which %s ha (%s%%) had a forested vegetation type in the current condition.",
    tr$name, report05_ha(tr$area_ha), report05_ha(tr$forest_ha), report05_pct(tr$forest_ha / tr$area_ha)
  ),
  af[, sprintf(
    "%s forest makes up %s%% of all forest today, %s (simulated median %s%%).",
    ageClass, report05_pct(cc), phrase, report05_pct(p50)
  )],
  "@fig-type-{@slug@} shows the same comparison for each vegetation type.",
  if (length(types_small)) {
    sprintf(
      "%s %s less than %s ha of forest and %s left out of the figure.",
      paste(report05_veg_label(types_small), collapse = ", "),
      if (length(types_small) == 1L) "has" else "have",
      report05_ha(min_ha),
      if (length(types_small) == 1L) "is" else "are"
    )
  },
  sep = "\n"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-type-{@slug@}
#| fig-cap: !expr cap_type
#| fig-height: !expr h_type
#| fig-width: 6.5
p_type
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (is.na(tr$sub_layer)) {
  cat("No ecological sub-region layer covers this tenure.\n")
} else if (!has_subs) {
  cat(sprintf("No %s in this tenure holds %s ha of forest or more.\n", tr$sub_kind, report05_ha(min_ha)))
} else {
  cat(
    sprintf("@fig-sub-{@slug@} shows all forest by %s.", tr$sub_kind),
    if (length(subs_small)) {
      sprintf(
        "Left out as smaller than %s ha of forest: %s.",
        report05_ha(min_ha), paste(subs_small, collapse = ", ")
      )
    },
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sub-{@slug@}

#| fig-height: !expr if (has_subs) h_sub else 3
#| fig-width: 6.5
p_sub
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(
  pp[, sprintf(
    "Old forest in patches of %s ha or more covered %s to %s ha in the simulated landscapes (median %s ha), against %s ha today, %s.",
    report05_ha(min_patch_ha), report05_ha(min), report05_ha(max), report05_ha(p50), report05_ha(cc),
    data.table::fcase(
      position == "below", "below the simulated range",
      position == "above", "above the simulated range",
      default = sprintf("at the %s percentile of the simulated values", report05_ordinal(round(cc_rank)))
    )
  )],
  "@fig-patch-{@slug@} shows the simulated distributions.",
  sep = "\n"
)
```
